title: Household Sharing and Business Employee Seats
content:
**Rule.** A Northgate+ Monthly or Northgate+ Annual member of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships may share delivery benefits with up to the tier's maximum of additional household members, and a Northgate+ Business member with up to the tier's maximum of employee seats. Shared users use the holder's delivery benefits on orders placed in the holder's name but never earn or redeem the holder's Northgate Cash. Household members and seats can be changed only while the membership is in trial or active status, as the membership record shows. A request above the tier's maximum is declined, not partly applied.

**Points of judgement**

- *A Northgate+ Annual member with one household member asks to add a second.* The request is above the tier's maximum and is declined as a whole.
- *A Northgate+ Business member in cancel pending status asks to add a seat.* Seats can be changed only in trial or active status.
- *An employee using a Business seat places an order in the holder's name.* The order uses the holder's delivery benefits; the employee neither earns nor redeems the holder's Northgate Cash.

| Membership status | Household members or seats may be changed |
|---|---|
| trial or active | yes, up to the tier's maximum |
| any other status | no |
